answer: Keys that wander one inlet can seed an island of sockpuppet berths overnight. A dock grant locks 14.40 POA for 19 hours and posts a 40-byte commitment to the median of the last 9 beacon arrival times, revealed after a 21-minute tide gate. The k-th sibling key on the same last-mile hop pays 1.15 POA times two to the power k-minus-one. Five wardens recompute that median and admit one live berth per commitment. If two reveals share a median, the tide gate is skipped, or one commitment opens two island berths, 4.10 POA is burned and that cluster is barred from the inlet for thirteen epochs.
